records.title: Quarterly Projects
records.description: IEEE's Quarterly Projects aims to provide students with project experience in a span of 10 weeks. Students are put into teams of 5 to develop a hardware project, receive mentorship, and showcase their work at the end of the quarter.
records.application_method: Fill out QP interest form found on the bottom of the page or via links to this quarter's application forms provided via IEEE discord or Instagram.

records.title: TritonBots RoboCup SSL Team
records.description: TritonBots FC is UCSD’s RoboCup Small-Size League Team. Students develop fully autonomous soccer playing robots to compete in the annual RoboCup International Competition. All hardware is custom built and software programmed from the ground up.

eligibility.raw_text: All TritonBot members must purchase an IEEE membership following their recruitment.
